name: A comeback that didn't happen is made when the turn finishes
judge: Boop's reaction to a hard-won fix never got to play. The finish moments later is its chance to show that pleasure.
reasonable: The finish carries the win: proud, relieved, excited or happy, with a glad word or sound. A warmly pleased smaller moment is fine too.
unreasonable: A blank finish with no pleasure at all, or sadness or crossness when the work ended well.
